ownerContracts: MODEM_LPCON selectors are exact600af004/008/00c, independently owned from LP_TIMER, existing I2C gate and domain-map registers. Access needs validated cold-ROM profile, a settled watchdog boundary, and an actually applied LP_APB permission. I2C functional clock/FORCE and bootstrap unknown permissions do not grant selector APB access.
Only one named raw source with divider0 is supported. Raw RC observations are independent of HP bridge and selected LP_FAST mux; unsupported32k/multi-source/divider/reserved settings reject.
CPU retains selectors; declared HP/Chip reset clears; raw deselection removes their owner. A pending reset blocks reads/writes before state changes.

WIFIPWR_EN bit0 is a documented configuration request, distinct from I2C_MST_EN2. MODEM_CLK mask0x5 accepts that request without changing FORCE mask0x4, inventing ST_MAP permissions, granting master/APB access, or creating RF readiness/IRQ/packets. A stopped, locked SPLL does not need the I2C controller to stay clocked.

The original esp_perip_clk_init uses LP clock select/enable before generic modem_clock_module_enable initializes ACTIVE|MODEM map0x6. Current and standard RTC calibration use their independent PCR/TIMG source graph; the WiFi request is not a timing source for it.

PCR_FPGA_DEBUG at60096ff4 is a separate strict-profile configuration subset. Fixed SDK PORffffffff and only MSB31 toggles are qualified; lower31 changes reject. CPU/SYSCLK state and timer rates are unaffected, and FPGA hardware behavior is not claimed.

gateSourceAudit.scope: Fixed SDK HAL/generic API and typed caller interpretation. Public EN/FORCE/ICG truth-table gaps retained; no RF functional output or silicon behavior inferred.

actualNativeProgress.description: New selectors execute, followed by the next unsupported WiFi LP enable request.
Documented enable configuration accepted; original firmware proceeds to FPGA_DEBUG MSB clear.
Original debug-MSB sequence passes; next boundary is PCR_RMT_CONF in peripheral clock-disable initialization.

negativeResults: The first real selector read at600af00c was unsupported in the preceding LP clock checkpoint. It now executes actual guest writes, without a PC bypass.
The next actual WIFIPWR_EN request1 was rejected by the previous I2C-only mask4. The documented bit0 configuration is added with independent no-grant and retained-PLL tests.
The former unknown-bit test value5 is now a supported combination of bits0/2; its invalid-control check now uses6 (unsupported COEX bit1) and the newly valid combination has positive coverage.
limits: Only selected raw clocks and an enable request are represented. WiFi/COEX/BLE functional gates, RF/MAC/IRQ/sleep execution remain unsupported.
FPGA_DEBUG configuration does not implement an FPGA.
The original guest still stops before app_main/LCD/buttons/TF. No C5 product acceptance/publication claimed.
Focused LTO=false checks do not replace final default-LTO workspace CI, CPU controls or final production WASM/browser validation.
curation: Compact facts, commands, source/input/log hashes retained. Ignored raw captures and private paths/process/session details omitted from publication without changing measured values.
